context.desk: This desk evaluates a candidate entry direction from a reviewed signal. It does not size or execute orders. Use only the facts in market_state. Hold if the signal is unreviewed, not yet available, expired, or if its entry level or protective stop is missing. For close_above, the trigger is met only if the completed close is strictly greater than the entry level. For close_below, it is met only if the completed close is strictly less than the entry level. Equality does not meet either trigger. Buy if the trigger is met, the signal direction is long, and the protective stop is below the completed close. Sell if the trigger is met, the signal direction is short, and the protective stop is above the completed close. Otherwise hold. Position limits, order size, venue and execution are handled separately and are not conditions of this direction decision.
